audit_scope.description: Trust model for EIP-1679 (Istanbul Hardfork), DAO Fork irregular state transition, EIP-2537 (BLS12-381 Precompiles), EIP-150 (Tangerine Whistle gas repricing), and EIP-7867 (Wallet Batch Transactions). Covers hardfork activation, precompile execution, gas economics, and wallet batch call flow control.

in_scope: Istanbul hardfork activation and gas repricing (EIP-1679)

misclassified_entities.reason: Calling Contract is an internal EVM component - smart contracts calling precompiles are part of the EVM execution environment, not external entities
EVM Execution Context is an internal EVM component representing the calling context that invokes BLS precompiles
EVM Calldata is internal EVM data passed to precompiles, not an external entity
EVM Gas Context is an internal EVM execution state providing available gas and input data, not an external entity
Calling Smart Contract is an internal EVM component invoking BLS precompiles within the execution environment
SELFDESTRUCT Beneficiary is an address designation within the EVM state, not an external entity that initiates interaction

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Block header propagation via P2P network
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Block producers (miners in PoW era) create and propagate blocks. During the DAO fork 10-block window, headers must contain the b'dao-hard-fork' extra_data marker. Producers are semi-trusted as they invest resources but can attempt to produce invalid blocks.

trusted_external_entities.name: DAO Token Holder
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Token holders submit withdrawal transactions to the recovery contract. The contract must validate token holdings and calculate proportional shares. Any address can call the function.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction senders can craft transactions to exploit underpriced IO-heavy opcodes for DoS attacks. Gas repricing in EIP-150 mitigates this by increasing costs for EXTCODESIZE, EXTCODECOPY, BALANCE, SLOAD, CALL family, and SELFDESTRUCT.

trusted_external_entities.name: DApp (EIP-7867)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: DApps submit batched call requests with atomicity and failure mode parameters. The wallet must validate flow control schemas, check capability support, and reject invalid combinations (e.g., rollback with no atomicity).

boundary_edges.security_assumption: During DAO fork 10-block window, block headers must contain b'dao-hard-fork' extra_data marker. Headers without the marker are rejected. Standard header validation (number, timestamp, gas, difficulty, parent hash) applies to all blocks.
Recovery contract validates token holdings and computes proportional shares. The contract must be secure against reentrancy and ensure correct distribution of recovered funds.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: EVM opcode execution with post-Tangerine Whistle gas costs
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Updated gas costs (EXTCODESIZE: 700, BALANCE: 400, SLOAD: 200, CALL: 700, SELFDESTRUCT: 5000+25000) must accurately reflect IO costs to prevent DoS. The 63/64 gas allocation rule bounds call depth exploitation.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: wallet_sendCalls RPC with flow control capabilities
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Wallet must validate flow control schema, verify capability scope (batch-scope required for call-scope), reject rollback mode with no atomicity, and correctly implement halt/continue/rollback failure semantics.

coverage_gaps: BLS12-381 precompile external entities (EXT-EVM-EXECUTION, EXT-CALLDATA, EXT-EVM-GAS-CONTEXT, EXT-SMART-CONTRACT) are all misclassified internal EVM components - the actual external boundary is at the transaction submission level
EXT-BENEFICIARY is an address target rather than an initiating entity
